behavior_groups: hand-computable scaled time series, mm centroid/volume and closed final bin
rectangular crop preserves raw/scaled samples and independent qform/sform; no overwrite
bounding rectangle retains interior values and clips margin to image
physical grid and determinant volume are unit-aware and endian-independent
empty region has no arbitrary bounds, mean or crop
nonfinite source values remain counted, never mistaken for finite means
opaque metadata is never silently dropped on ROI crop
seconds/milliseconds/microseconds convert; frequency and singleton axes do not invent time
invalid CLI range/frame/bins/label/margin fails without creating an output
downstream manifest consumer exports CSV and crop only for the matching case; existing output refused
